meta.project: Kathryn Portal — Real Estate Transaction Management
meta.changelog_1_1: Document sets (M:N), template library file scope on stored_files, conditional_rule_sets, project checklist provenance, google_drive_library_roots.

users.description: Team members that log into the portal (Kathryn + coordinators).

user_invites.description: Email invites to new team members.

project_assignments.description: Join table: which user works which transaction.

contacts.description: Everyone Kathryn deals with (agents, buyers, sellers, escrow, lenders) for autocomplete.

clients.description: Agents Kathryn repeatedly works for (owning agent of a transaction).

projects.description: Transactions. Core entity that almost everything else references.

project_parties.description: All parties tied to a transaction (buyer, seller, co-agent, escrow staff, etc.).

document_types.description: Master list of ~50–60 CAR forms + custom types.

document_sets.description: Named bundles of document_types (e.g. Standard Listing SFR). Same document_type can belong to many sets (M:N via document_set_members). Rules attach sets to transactions.

document_set_members.description: M:N — which document_types are in which set, with required flag and ordering.

conditional_rules.description: Checklist rules: triggers (see triggers_json) + links to document_sets and/or inline document rows. Drives project checklist at creation.

columns.name: triggers_json
columns.description: Array of {field, value} for AND matching (transactionType, propertyType, hoa, county, ...).

conditional_rule_sets.description: When a rule matches, these document_sets are merged into the checklist (union of members).

project_documents.description: Per-transaction document instance (checklist row). source_document_set_id records which resolved set contributed this row (audit / provenance).

project_document_status_history.description: Audit trail for document status transitions.

project_folders.description: Auto-created folder tree per transaction (supports subfolders).

google_drive_library_roots.description: Org-level Google Drive folder(s) for template-library masters (separate from per-transaction google_drive_folder_links).

stored_files.description: Transaction files and template-library master PDFs. storage_scope=transaction requires project_id; template_library uses null project_id (library masters for DocuSign template builder).

columns.name: google_drive_library_root_id
columns.description: When library file is placed under an org Drive root.

google_drive_folder_links.description: Optional mapping between portal folders and Google Drive folders.

docusign_templates.description: One saved template per document_type (signature coords live here).

docusign_template_fields.description: Saved field coordinates (tabs) for signature / initial / date / text / checkbox.

docusign_envelope_documents.description: Which project_documents are in an envelope + which template was applied.

docusign_webhook_events.description: Raw audit of DocuSign callbacks (envelope status, signed, declined...).

email_templates.description: Reusable email bodies with variable placeholders.

emails.description: Sent/received emails logged on the transaction communication thread.

project_deadlines.description: Transaction deadlines surfaced on the calendar.

reminder_drafts.description: Auto-drafted reminder emails awaiting Kathryn's review (never auto-sent).

calendar_events.description: Unified calendar (can also be implemented as a view over deadlines/tasks/reminders).

integration_accounts.description: Per-user OAuth tokens for DocuSign/Gmail/Google Drive.

notifications.description: In-app notifications (document signed, reminder drafted, etc.).

activity_logs.description: SOW: all user activity is logged. Broad-scope audit trail.

hub_tables.reason: Referenced by almost every transactional table (documents, tasks, folders, files, emails, envelopes, deadlines, notifications, logs).
Referenced by every audit/ownership column (created_by, sent_by, assigned_to, etc.).
Central directory for agents, buyers, sellers, escrow, lenders — reused across parties and recipients.
Bundles document_types; rules attach sets; checklist rows can record source_document_set_id.
